title: Our partners
text: To ensure the success of every project, we surround ourselves with a trusted ecosystem. Discover our {0} who share our high standards and contribute to our region's vitality.

items.name: Déménagement Jezequel
items.description: A family-owned business specializing in residential moves and corporate relocations. Known for its rigorous logistics, it operates locally and nationwide.

items.name: Investir en Finistère
items.description: An economic development agency dedicated to businesses looking to set up in Finistère. It coordinates local stakeholders to ease business relocation.

items.name: Brest en Vue
items.description: A local platform dedicated to discovering and promoting Brest. It highlights the activities, local shops, and events that bring the area to life.

items.name: Brest Life
items.description: A territorial branding initiative led by the Brest metropolitan area. It highlights the local quality of life, spirit of innovation, and professional opportunities.

items.name: Route Mandarine
items.description: An artisanal Breton workshop creating fragrances and skincare products inspired by the coast. It offers a sensory escape rooted in the region.

items.name: Crédit Agricole Finistère
items.description: A cooperative bank and a key economic player in the department. It supports individuals and professionals in all their local financial projects.

items.name: Selfstock Brest
items.description: Selfstock Brest offers secure, 24/7 drive-up storage units. A flexible and practical self-storage solution to keep your belongings safe while you settle into your new home.

items.name: Technopole Brest Iroise
items.description: A hub for scientific and technological innovation in western Brittany. It supports innovative startups, especially in marine sciences and digital technologies.

items.name: Résidences Beausoleil
items.description: Next-generation residences providing a secure, friendly environment for seniors. The group emphasizes well-being, hospitality, and quality services.

items.name: Holiworking
items.description: An innovative HR solution enabling company employees to work remotely from abroad. It combines geographic mobility with a secure legal framework.

items.name: Résidences les Jardins d'Arcadie
items.description: A senior serviced residence provider promoting autonomy and social connection. Residents enjoy a peaceful setting, shared spaces, and dedicated staff.

items.name: Mona Design
items.description: A design studio crafting modern graphics and personalized items. Its creations bring an elegant, warm touch to interior spaces.

items.name: Blue Solutions
items.description: A pioneer in electric mobility specializing in innovative solid-state batteries. Located near Quimper, the company invests heavily in the energy transition.

items.name: Bolloré Transport & Logistics
items.description: A major player in supply chain management, freight forwarding, and transport infrastructure. The group delivers transport solutions worldwide.

items.name: Thales
items.description: A global high-tech leader across aerospace, defense, and digital security. Its Brest site focuses on cutting-edge naval and submarine expertise.

items.name: Ifremer
items.description: A world-renowned public oceanographic research institute based in Plouzané. Its research teams study marine biodiversity, ocean floors, and planetary climate.

items.name: Naval Group
items.description: An international defense contractor building on a legacy of military dockyards. The company designs, builds, and maintains naval ships and strategic submarines.

items.name: Ceva Santé Animale
items.description: A global veterinary pharmaceutical company developing vaccines and medicines for livestock and companion animals. It champions a sustainable approach to animal health.

items.name: DCI Environnement
items.description: A specialist in the collection, recovery, and recycling of industrial and commercial waste. It works daily to preserve regional resources.

items.name: Arkea
items.description: A cooperative, regional banking group with historic headquarters in Finistère. It is strongly committed to sustainable finance and supporting the local economy.

items.name: Rehlko
items.description: A recognized industrial manufacturer of generator sets and autonomous energy systems (formerly Kohler/SDMO). Its engineering and production hub is anchored in Brest.

items.name: Clinique de la baie
items.description: A leading private healthcare facility located in Morlaix, part of the Vivalto Santé group. It offers comprehensive surgical care and high-standard local medical services.

items.name: Accenture
items.description: A global professional services firm specializing in strategy, consulting, technology, and digital transformation. It helps organizations optimize and modernize operations.

items.name: Presantra
items.description: An occupational health service operating across western Brittany. Its experts assist employers and employees in preventing workplace hazards and promoting safety.

items.name: Asten
items.description: A Brest-based digital services company (IT) expert in cybersecurity, managed services, and local datacenter cloud hosting. It supports digital transformations for businesses.

items.name: Institut de la corrosion Brest
items.description: A research center specializing in materials science and degradation in marine environments. Its engineers run critical testing for naval and offshore industries.

items.name: Eau du Ponant
items.description: A local public utility company managing drinking water distribution and sanitation in Finistère. It provides a public service dedicated to sustainable water resource management.

items.name: France Energies Marines
items.description: A national research institute dedicated to offshore renewable energy. It unites public and private stakeholders to unlock the ocean's energy potential.

items.name: Institut Mines Telecom
items.description: The leading group of engineering and management graduate schools in France, represented locally by IMT Atlantique. It trains managers and researchers in advanced technologies.

items.name: Brest Business School
items.description: A Brittany-based business school known for international programs and work-study degrees. It trains future leaders in modern commerce and management practices.

seo.title: Blue Mind - Our partners
seo.description: Discover our service provider and client partners who share our high standards and contribute to the vitality of Finistère.
